aboutText: Thy Tran Architecture is a Melbourne-based design studio specialising in residential and commercial architecture and interior design. With a portfolio spanning projects from Blairgowrie to Bulleen and Elsternwick to Richmond, we create spaces that are functional, beautiful, and deeply considered. We are not ones to chase trends; instead, we focus on timeless design that suits how you live, work, and grow.
servicesText: From concept to completion, Thy Tran Architecture delivers residential homes, renovations, aged care facilities, and commercial spaces across Melbourne's inner and outer suburbs.

services.title: Residential Architecture
services.desc: New homes and major renovations designed around your lifestyle, from beach houses in Blairgowrie to townhouses in Richmond.

services.title: Commercial Design
services.desc: Thoughtful commercial spaces that balance function and aesthetic, including mixed-use developments on Rathdowne Street.

services.title: Interior Design
services.desc: Full interior design services ensuring every detail inside your home reflects the architecture's vision and your personality.

services.title: Renovations & Extensions
services.desc: Smart renovations that unlock the potential of existing homes, like our Black Rock Renovation and Elsternwick Delight projects.

services.title: Aged Care Facilities
services.desc: Compassionate design for aged care environments, creating spaces that support dignity, comfort, and community connection.

services.title: Project Documentation
services.desc: Detailed construction drawings and documentation ensuring your project is built exactly as designed, with precision and care.

reviews.text: Thy Tran Architecture designed our beach house in Blairgowrie and the result exceeded every expectation. The gabled form sits perfectly in the coastal landscape and the interior spaces are flooded with natural light. Exceptional attention to detail throughout.
reviews.name: David Mitchell

reviews.text: Working with Thy on our Richmond townhouse project was a fantastic experience. They understood the challenges of a tight urban site and delivered a home that feels spacious, private, and beautifully connected to the streetscape. Highly recommended.
reviews.name: Sarah Chen

reviews.text: We engaged Thy Tran Architecture for our aged care facility at Rushall Park and were impressed by their ability to balance clinical requirements with genuinely warm, homely spaces. The residents and staff love the finished design.
reviews.name: Michael O'Brien
